description: Fetch one specific chord voicing by its numeric id, as returned by get_chord_chart_by_name. Use this to re-render a chart the user already saw without looking it up again.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

format.description: Which representations to return. Defaults to "text", which includes a direct URL to a PNG of the chart — embed that where your surface renders images. Use "image" or "both" only if you need the PNG bytes inline; they cost image tokens and many clients bury them.

id.description: Numeric chord id, e.g. 123 (a numeric string like "123" also works).

name: get_chord_chart_by_id
title: Get a chord chart by id
